behaviour.summary: A full reserved-seating plan for a single instance is served to an unauthenticated caller: venue, background image, areas, per-seat coordinates and identifiers. Seat-level legibility below the exhibitor already exists at the arts-venue tier without any credential, on the vendor's own demonstration client.
behaviour.testable_as: GET https://system.spektrix.com/apitesting/api/v3/instances/{id}/plan with no credential returns 200 and a document whose top-level members include venue, areas, seats and capacity.
behaviour.consequence_for_agents: Legibility is not the missing piece. An agent can already see the room; what it cannot do anywhere in this estate is take a stated, irrevocable position in it. This entry exists to stop the specification claiming credit for a gap that is already closed.

half_life_basis: The observation is of a demonstration tenant the vendor may reconfigure or retire at will, and unauthenticated read is precisely the setting most likely to be tightened. Ninety days.

citation.quote: Web/Public mode does not require any authentication.

evidence.assertion: 200 with a seat-level plan; top-level members observed: type, name, venue, backgroundImageUrl, x, y, areas, seats, capacity, maxZoomWeb, maxZoomMobile, vertices, id.

notes: Read only. No basket was created, no write path was exercised, and whether the vendor sanctions write operations against this demonstration client is unverified — see corpus/README.md on the probing discipline.
